headline: Organic growth accelerates · EPS outlook raised
summary_short: Q2 revenue rose to $4.42B (+10% reported, organic +5%) as pricing offset rising commodity costs; adjusted diluted EPS grew to $2.09 (+11% y/y), and Ecolab raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $8.05-$8.25.
summary_long: Net sales of $4.42B rose 10% (organic +5%) as pricing improved to 4% on the energy-surcharge rollout, offsetting higher commodity costs; growth engines Global High-Tech (+29%) and Life Sciences (+15%) led. Reported operating margin held near 17.2% while organic operating margin expanded 40bps to 18.8%. GAAP diluted EPS $1.90 (+3% y/y); adjusted diluted EPS $2.09 (+11% y/y). Cash swelled to $5.14B (+$4.62B q/q) on financing tied to the recently closed CoolIT and Ovivo Electronics acquisitions; short-term and long-term debt both rose accordingly. Ecolab raised FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $8.05-$8.25 (from $8.03-$8.23) and guided Q3 adjusted EPS to $2.13-$2.23.

drivers.explanation: Accelerating organic growth (+5%) from volume gains in Food & Beverage, Institutional, and Light Water plus 29% growth in Global High-Tech and 15% in Life Sciences, despite a ~1% volume headwind from Middle East disruptions.
Pricing improved to 4% on early benefits of the energy surcharge rollout, helping offset rising commodity costs; underlying volume growth strengthened despite the Middle East disruption headwind.
Adjusted gross margin fell ~60bps y/y due to the Ovivo Electronics acquisition; excluding that impact, organic gross margin was stable as pricing offset higher commodity costs.

Reported margin lags organic (+40bps) due to higher Corporate segment costs: $59.0M transformational acquisition amortization (vs $48.9M) and $51.1M special charges (vs $27.1M) tied to CoolIT/Purolite/Ovivo integration and One Ecolab.

Adjusted net income rose 9% as accelerating pricing offset higher commodity costs and growth investments; reported net income (+2%) is diluted by higher special charges and interest expense from acquisition financing.
Adjusted operating income growth plus a $0.04/share favorable currency translation; reported EPS growth (+3%) is smaller due to higher special (gains) and charges and interest expense.
New debt issued to fund the CoolIT and Ovivo Electronics acquisitions raised cash and long-term debt; net interest expense rose $10M on lower cash balances and new acquisition debt.

CEO cites strong execution, accelerating organic growth, stabilized organic gross margin ex-Ovivo, and productivity as drivers of double-digit adjusted EPS growth; raised FY guidance reflects confidence in second-half pricing (5-6%) offsetting commodity costs.
